warnings: IDENTICAL LEVEL SET TO A-06, WHICH IS THE POINT OF CHECKING IT. Both sheets print the same five levels and the same 2.55/3.10/3.40/0.60 chain closing on +9.65, drawn from two different directions. That is an independent repeat, not a copy of one reading - and it is why A-06's +9.65 is preferred over S-02's +10.00 note (see A-06's own warning).

*** THE x GRID BUBBLES ON THIS ELEVATION RUN 4-3-2-1, RIGHT TO LEFT, AND THE CHAIN IS PRINTED IN THAT ORDER TOO: 1.00 eave + 3.00 + 2.20 + 3.50 + 1.00 eave under 8.70. It is the mirror of รูปด้าน 1 because it looks at the opposite face. The bay widths are the same three numbers in reverse, so the grid is confirmed again, not contradicted. Anyone parsing the chain left-to-right and assuming it starts at grid 1 will place every element 8.70 m out.
Door and window marks are not transcribed here - same reason as A-04/A-05/A-06, with A-14/A-15 the authoritative schedule.
This file is one of three views on หน้า08 per §3.

OPENING VOCABULARY RESOLVED ON A-14/A-15 (หน้า15, หน้า16). This file records no ป/น marks because the glyphs are unreadable at this scan's resolution. The schedules give the full closed list - eight door types ป1-ป8 and nine window types น1-น9, seventeen marks - so any later pass adding positions to this sheet has a fixed vocabulary to match against and cannot invent a mark. What is still missing is only WHICH type sits in WHICH opening on this drawing.
